# AME

> A quiz/exam learning platform with a first-class agent surface. Agents can
> author question banks, assemble quizzes and exams, publish them, and read
> learner stats — all over plain HTTP + JSON. This file is the entry point;
> read it first.

This is NOT an MCP server. There is no JSON-RPC. You call a normal REST API
with a bearer token, plus one convenience dispatcher (`/v1/agents/run`) for
composite and write operations.

## Getting a key

Registration is gated by a shared access code (the operator sets
`AME_AGENT_ACCESS_CODE`; if unset, registration is disabled).

```
POST /v1/agents/register
{ "label": "my-agent", "scopes": ["quiz.read", "quiz.write"], "accessCode": "<code>" }
-> 201 { "apiKey": "<id>_<secret>", "userId", "openapiUrl", "skillManifestUrl" }
```

Send the key on every request: `Authorization: Bearer <apiKey>`.

Scopes: `quiz.read`, `quiz.write`, `attempt.read`, `attempt.write`, `stats.read`,
`feedback.write`, `plan.write`. `admin` cannot be requested here.

## Discovery

- `GET /v1/agents/skill.json` — machine-readable tool list. Each tool carries an
  `input_schema` and the REST `method`/`path` it maps to. Add `?strict=1` to drop
  the method/path/scope hints. Top-level `run` block lists the runnable tools.
- `GET /v1/agents/openapi.json` — full OpenAPI schema (scope: `quiz.read`).
- `GET /v1/agents/activity` — your own call log, newest first (scope: `quiz.read`).

## Two ways to act

1. **Reads + simple writes** — call the REST endpoint directly at the
   method/path from `skill.json` (e.g. `GET /v1/quizzes`, `GET /v1/questions`).
2. **Composite / write tools** — POST to the dispatcher:

   ```
   POST /v1/agents/run
   { "tool": "<name>", "params": { ... } }
   ```

   Runnable tools (each requires `quiz.write`):
   - `quiz.import`     — create a draft quiz + draft questions from JSON.
     `params: { source: "<json string>" }` where the JSON has
     `{ title, course?, objectives?, questions: [{ kind, prompt, payload, points?, explanation? }] }`.
   - `question.create` — batch-create bank questions.
     `params: { questions: [{ kind, prompt, payload, points?, tags? }] }`.
   - `question.promote`— promote one draft question to live. `params: { id }`.
   - `quiz.update`     — patch metadata / publish. `params: { id, title?, status?, objectives? }`.

## Authoring a quiz end to end

1. `POST /v1/agents/run` `quiz.import` → returns `quizId` (quiz is `draft`).
2. `POST /v1/agents/run` `quiz.update` `{ id: quizId, status: "active" }`.
   Publishing auto-promotes the quiz's draft questions to live. A quiz needs at
   least one question before it can go active; archived quizzes cannot be
   re-activated.

## Data-model rules (violating these returns 422 or silently mis-grades)

- Multiple-choice options are **bare strings**: `payload.options: ["a", "b"]`.
  Never `[{ "text": "a" }]`. The grader and the UI both require bare strings.
- Question `kind` is one of `mc`, `tf`, `short`, `essay`, `code`.
- No scheduled exams: there are no `opens_at` / `closes_at` fields.
- Auth is email + password only. No SSO/SAML.
- `code` questions are graded by exemplar/manual comparison — there is no code
  runner.

## Task playbooks

Worked, step-by-step recipes live in the repo under `agents/<name>/SKILL.md`:
`generate-questions`, `adaptive-generation`, `analyze-performance`.
